sources.title: LLM Backdoors at the Inference Level: The Threat of Poisoned Templates
sources.snippet: Executive Summary Pillar Security researchers have uncovered a dangerous new supply chain attack vector targeting the AI inference pipeline. This novel technique, termed " Poisoned GGUF Templates," allows attackers to embed malicious instructions that execute during model inference, compromising AI outputs.
